001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission;
004import org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin;
005import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
006
007import java.util.Collection;
008import java.util.List;
009
010/**
011 * Shop permission manager. Comment: Something in QuickShop just like Flags in other plugins.
012 */
013public interface ShopPermissionManager {
014
015  /**
016   * Gets all groups was registered.
017   *
018   * @return Groups.
019   */
020  @NotNull
021  List<String> getGroups();
022
023  /**
024   * Gets the permission list of a group.
025   *
026   * @param group The group.
027   *
028   * @return The permission list.
029   */
030  @NotNull
031  List<String> getGroupPermissions(@NotNull String group);
032
033  /**
034   * Check if specified group exists.
035   *
036   * @param group Group name.
037   *
038   * @return True if exists.
039   */
040  boolean hasGroup(@NotNull String group);
041
042  /**
043   * Get permissions of specified group was granted.
044   *
045   * @param group      Group name.
046   * @param permission Permission.
047   *
048   * @return True if granted.
049   */
050  boolean hasPermission(@NotNull String group, @NotNull BuiltInShopPermission permission);
051
052  /**
053   * Get permissions of specified group was granted.
054   *
055   * @param group      Group name.
056   * @param namespace  Plugin instance for namespace.
057   * @param permission Permission name.
058   *
059   * @return True if granted.
060   */
061  boolean hasPermission(@NotNull String group, @NotNull Plugin namespace, @NotNull String permission);
062
063  /**
064   * Register a group with specified permissions and name.
065   *
066   * @param group       Group name.
067   * @param permissions Permissions.
068   */
069  void registerGroup(@NotNull String group, @NotNull Collection<String> permissions);
070
071  /**
072   * Register a permission to specified group.
073   *
074   * @param group      Group name.
075   * @param namespace  Plugin instance for namespace.
076   * @param permission Permission name.
077   *
078   * @throws IllegalArgumentException throws if group not exists
079   */
080  void registerPermission(@NotNull String group, @NotNull Plugin namespace, @NotNull String permission);
081
082  /**
083   * Unregister specified group.
084   *
085   * @param group Group name.
086   */
087  void unregisterGroup(@NotNull String group);
088
089  /**
090   * Unregister specified permission from specified group.
091   *
092   * @param group      Group name.
093   * @param namespace  Plugin instance for namespace.
094   * @param permission Permission name.
095   */
096  void unregisterPermission(@NotNull String group, @NotNull Plugin namespace, @NotNull String permission);
097}
